## What changed

<!-- Issue ID and a short summary. Keep pull requests small. -->

## Evidence (Definition of Done, team pack 01 §5)

- [ ] CI is green (link the run)
- [ ] Build artifact or staging URL, if relevant
- [ ] API or migration changes listed, with rollback steps
- [ ] Physical-device evidence for Android behaviour changes
- [ ] Screenshots of UI changes, including failure states
- [ ] Accessibility findings noted
- [ ] Known issues listed
- [ ] Deployment and rollback steps

## Safety checks

- [ ] No secrets, credentials or private keys in the diff
- [ ] No real customer data; any demo data is visibly labelled
- [ ] No unverified claims ("no logs", "fastest", "unlimited", "fully anonymous")
- [ ] Security-sensitive change? A second reviewer is assigned
